summary: Iteration 5 (full rebuild, ABC Insure white-label). Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_platform.py with 18 tests, all passing. Covered: stats for IN/MY/ID, meta, cases per market plus status/band/q filters (q='(' now returns 200), POST /cases validation (422) and create->GET, status transitions (400 on invalid), proposal (400 before visit or with an invalid product), notes, checklist, partner API key (401 without or with a wrong key), v1 list by market, decision (400 for a bad decision or a blank request_info comment, 409 when not proposal_submitted), request_info -> resubmit -> sandbox approve -> quoted, seeded proposal_submitted leads (ZIN-26002, ZMY-26001, ZID-26003), geo search/climate/surroundings, team add/duplicate/patch/404. Frontend (Playwright, 1920x1080): these flows passed: landing CTAs go to /quote; no Zurich text on /, /quote, report or console; step 1 and step 2 gating; live address suggestions (6) set the coords; no back button; 7 steps -> report-loading -> protection-report with 6 cover cards in 2 columns, exposure-profile, insights and a social-proof block labelled sample; submit-review dialog (phone validation) -> ZIN-26024 success; NEW badge in Cases; Overview has all 10 KPIs and 8 panels in each market, with the correct currency (₹ Cr, RM M/K, Rp T/M) and the persona list scoped to the market; case filters; case detail on all 8 tabs (checklist persists after reload, F1 jumps to evidence, annotation-P2-0 plate fields, P1-P3 thumbs, 5 video frames, live climate chart, live OSM surroundings, map toggle); full broker workflow contacted -> visit_scheduled -> visited -> proposal with live advisory checks -> Proposal submitted; note added to the audit trail; dev portal shows 3 endpoints, lookup works, approve -> quoted, and insurer-decision shows on the Proposal tab; Team add, toggle persists, duplicate-email toast; Team nav hidden for agent personas. No JS page errors. Found 1 functional bug in the sandbox toast, plus an access-guard gap, data-fidelity issues on SME-created cases and mobile layout issues.

minor.issue: The case ignores most of what the SME entered. Industry, employees, revenue, photos and machinery come from a hero template. The SME picked Manufacturing with no activity, and the case shows 'Auto components · 120 employees' plus CNC photos, even though no photos were uploaded. Template mapping is keyword-only on activity/category (defaults to in3). Industry should at least come from the journey category/activity, and headcount from the journey.
Only the India market is supported (counter lead-IN, hero in*). There is no market field, so MY/ID SMEs cannot submit. Acceptable if this is intended.
market is not validated. An unknown market (e.g. XX) returns 200 with empty data instead of 400.
There is no DELETE endpoint for cases or agents, so test runs cannot clean up after themselves except with reset-demo.

ui_bugs.issue: The success toast 'Decision sent...' fires even when the API errors (409, or 400 for a blank request_info comment). The user sees an error toast and a success toast together. Cause: call() swallows the error, so the .then(toast.success) still runs. Fix: have call() return a boolean or rethrow, and only toast success when the call succeeds.

If you switch the persona to an agent (e.g. Imran) while on /console/team, the team table stays visible and fully usable. The Team page has no admin guard (only the nav link is hidden), so agents can also open it directly by URL. It should redirect or show 'Admins only'.
